gaps: No rule specifies how the TRAN-RECORD written to the transaction file is built; assumed each DALYTRAN-* field is copied to the matching TRAN-* field, including TRAN-PROC-TS (ctx.now() is not used).
Duplicate-key handling on the transaction write: assumed ctx.write_transaction raises Abend itself; any other exception it raises is converted to Abend.
Display format of the processed/rejected counts is unspecified; printed as the label immediately followed by the plain integer.
Expiration-date comparison uses Python string (code point) ordering rather than any specific collating sequence.
The reason description passed to write_reject is padded/truncated to 76 characters and the reason code is limited to 4 unsigned digits, following the trailer layout in BR-CBTRN02C-005.
Reason 109 from a failed account rewrite (account key no longer in ctx.accounts) is only recorded in the per-transaction state; no rule says it causes a reject after posting, so it does not.
Account record not found for a category balance's account ID: no rule specifies the behaviour; assumed abend.
Card cross-reference not found by account ID: no rule specifies the behaviour; assumed abend.
The 'fee step' is mentioned but never specified; implemented as a no-op.
Return code handling is not specified; return_code left at 0.
Disclosure group read errors other than not-found cannot occur with the dict API; only not-found paths are implemented.
ctx.now() is called once per interest transaction (rule says current time; both timestamps share that value).
Run date parameter shorter/longer than 10 chars is padded/truncated to 10 (MOVE semantics).
